# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

**Best overall: Soundcore Space One (about $100, or about $80 with a code)**
- Best Products named it their top sub-$100 pick for its strong adaptive ANC, balanced sound, comfortable rotating cups, and 55-hour battery with ANC off ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)).
- Dealectric lists it at $99.99 with 40 hours of battery with ANC on, multipoint Bluetooth, and LDAC on Android. LDAC doesn't work while two devices are connected.
- It's heavier than some rivals and has no sweat resistance, so it's not the pick for workouts.
- **[Buy at Soundcore's official US store](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one)**
- Dealectric says code AFSC20 took $19.99 off in a cart test on 2026-10-22, bringing it to about $80. The code expires 2026-12-31 and doesn't apply to items already on sale, so check the final price at checkout. This is an affiliate link, and Dealectric earns a commission if you buy through it ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-space-one)).

**Best noise cancelling for the money: Soundcore Space Q45 (around $100)**
- RTINGS rates it the best budget ANC headphone it has tested, with excellent isolation against engine rumble and office chatter. Battery is about 28 hours, and some owners report the headband cracking over time ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)).

**Best cheaper option: Soundcore Life Q30**
- RTINGS' top over-ear pick under $100. It has good ANC, about 44 hours of battery, and a comfortable fit. It leaks a fair amount of sound, which matters in a quiet office ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)).
- RTINGS also recommends the Soundcore Life Q20 (2024) as a cheaper alternative with nearly the same noise isolation and 49 hours of battery. Its build is plasticky ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)).

**Other good picks** (from [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/) and [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/))
- **Sony WH-CH720N, about $99:** very light at 192 g, with good ANC, but only SBC and AAC codecs.
- **Edifier W820NB Plus, about $79:** 49-hour battery, LDAC, and plush earcups, but no case.
- **JBL Tune 760NC, about $79:** bass-heavy sound, with a better mic than the others but weaker ANC (RTINGS).
- **1MORE SonoFlow SE, about $65:** 70-hour battery, but weaker ANC.
- **Edifier Atom Max, about $45:** the cheapest pick, with up to 44 dB of noise reduction claimed.

I only have a direct purchase link for the Space One. For the others, the review pages above link to retailers. Prices vary by retailer and change often, so confirm the price before you buy.

**Quick recommendation:** get the Space One if you can use the discount code. If you want the strongest ANC and don't mind a more fragile headband, get the Q45. If you're on a tight budget, get the Life Q30 or Edifier Atom Max.
